run_bench_ivf_flat_panorama: run the benchmark script to compare IVF Flat and IVF FlatPanorama index recall and QPS on SIFT1M or GIST1M datasets
eval_recall_function: evaluate recall and queries per second for a FAISS index at a given nprobe value and print timing stats
eval_and_plot_function: build a FAISS index from a factory string, train it, evaluate recall across nprobe values, and plot results
get_ivf_index_function: extract the underlying IVF index from a FAISS index that may be wrapped in a PreTransform
run_bench_with_dataset_arg: run the benchmark with the --dataset argument to choose between sift1m and gist1m datasets for index comparison
